text:
Wiesbaden’s median asking rent sits at 14.0 €/m² in June 2026, placing the city 10th among the 37 most expensive German markets. Year‑on‑year rents are up 5.3 % and have risen 24.1 % over the past five years, while the asking premium over existing rents is 52 %.

The market remains balanced with a 2.0 % vacancy rate and 27 days on market; 26 % of listings are let within a week. Affordability is moderate – a 60 m² unit costs about 840 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 14.9 %.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.77 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 14.35 €/m² and 15.06 €/m², implying a 5.5 % increase.
